descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
**Noun Town: Home is a standalone Mixed Reality version of the award-winning Noun Town Language Learning game. If you already own Noun Town Language Learning, you don’t need to grab this one as it contains the same Mixed Reality gameplay.**

[media]

# Your Home, Your Learning

✔ Learn 800+ words and phrases

✔ Choose to learn: English, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Ukrainian, Russian, Greek and Arabic


✔ Stay motivated with "Daily Goals" and "Learning Streaks"

✔ Play the Superseeker and Alpha-Bash mini-games and use the auto-revision system to lock in your learning

✔ Customize your room, label household items, and create your own memory palace to help you remember

✔ Practice speaking with 16 NPCs using speech recognition, preparing you for real conversations

[media]
